main_text.p: קרמני m. Antiquus, Antiquum, 1.Sam.24.14. Orientalis, Ezech.47.18. Plural. וקדמנים Et priores, superiores, antiqui, Job.18.20. Foem. וכשנים קדמניות Et sicut anni antiqui, Malach.3.4.

קרה Obtenebratus, Obscuratus, Atratus fuit, Ater, Atratus, Pullatus incesit vel ivit, Ater, Teter fuit. Praeterit. וקדר Et obtenebrabitur super eos dies, Mich.3.6. Partic. קדר Atratus, Ater, Psal.35.14. Plur. וקדרים Et pullati, Job.5.11. Hiph.Praeter. והקדרתי Et atratas reddam stellas eorum, faciam ut tenebrescant, Ezech.32.7. Fut. ואקדיר Et atratum reddidi, Ezech.31.15. Hithp.Praeterit. וישמים התקדרו Et cali obscurati sunt, 1.Reg.18.45.

קרש Parari, Praeparari, Destinari, ad aliquid generaliter: In specie, Sacrari, Consecrari, Sanctificari, Sanctum, Sacrum esse vel fieri. Praeter. קדושתיך Sanctior sum te, Jesa.65.5. id est, קדוש אני ממך juxta Hebraeos. Futur. יקדש Sanctum esto, Exod.29.37. Niph.Praet. ונקדש Et sanctificabitur, Exod.29.43. Pih. קדש Sacravit, Consecravit, Sanctificavit, Reparavit, Restauravit ad sanctum usum: Item, Praeparavit, Edixit, Indixit, cum de bello aut jejunio dicitur. Praeter. קדש Consecravit rex, 1.Reg.8.64, &c. Pyh.Particip. המקדש Quisquis sanctificatus fuerit, Ezech.48.11. Plur. המקדשים Qui consecrati sunt, 2.Paralip.26.18, &c. Hiph. Praeter. גם אותם הקדיש Etiam illa consecravit, 2.Sam.8.11. Infin. vel Imper. הקדש Praeparando vel Prapara eos, Jer.12.3. Hithp.Praet. התקדש חג Sanctificatur festum, Jef.30.29.

page.notes: Hebrew words and vowel points are read from a low-resolution scan; the Hebrew forms, especially the vowel-pointed ones, may be misprinted or misread. Doubtful Hebrew: קרוט (Atror), קרניית (Atratè), and the Hebrew in the קרש entry. "Jesa.65.5" and "Jef.30.29" are printed as shown (Jesa / Jef). The Latin "Prapara" and "cali" are printed as such. The headwords at the left are large Hebrew letters and are transcribed inline as paragraph openings. The catchword קדוש is at the lower right.
